# SEO-037: Give every indexable route a distinct title

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

No two indexable routes share an identical title string, and templated titles interpolate a value that varies per route rather than only a constant site suffix.

## Rationale

Identical titles across routes leave nothing in the label to tell one result from another, and the engine has to fall back on page text to differentiate pages that the site itself failed to differentiate.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Build titles from the route's own primary subject plus at most one constant suffix. For collection and paginated routes, include the discriminator - page number, filter value, or locale - so the generated strings stay distinct rather than collapsing onto one value.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Gather the title from every route in the route inventory, then group identical strings and report each group holding more than one route.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: `title-distinct-across-routes`

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
